title: Proven Navir

hook: A quiet, focused Fungril retriever with goggles and an oversized bag, trying to open an untolled trade route across the river.

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A small Fungril retriever wears river goggles, a mushroom-cap hood, and an overloaded bag of stones, tokens, and water-bright samples.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Focused to the point of nearly disappearing into the work, diving under toll-chains for the older stones beneath them. Wants one untolled route to stay nameless, because the moment it has a name it has a price.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: A question to ask A local perspective A grounded reason this place matters
